chose: OutboundRefused (objective OB3) fires for the game feed when at least three of its requests in 30 minutes were refused (4xx or 5xx) and none was answered ok. A timeout among the refusals does not clear it, so a mix of refusals and timeouts, which clears OutboundNoAnswer, is still heard. Other callers are left out. The owner asked for it on 2026-11-21.
options: the game feed only, refusals with no ok, a timeout not clearing it
the game feed only, refusals only, anything but a refusal clearing it
every caller, refusals with no ok
fold it into OutboundNoAnswer as any non-ok outcome with no ok
gray: The owner chose the game feed and 'refused with no ok', but nothing said what a timeout among the refusals does. Clearing on it would leave a mix of 429s and timeouts heard by neither alert. Every caller was left out because the nudge's 410s are normal and the pollers' failing alerts already read their refusals.
undo: Delete the OutboundRefused rule and its three tests; or drop the caller="game_feed" matcher to judge every caller.
